changelog.note: New trick kinds: draw, reroll, affix (random prefixes and suffixes), socket (spell a 3-letter word into the trick) and enchanting morphs. Random tricks roll a seeded stream per use; bots plan them from 8 imagined outcomes and replan after the real roll. Hands over 8 tiles plan with their 50 best words. Heuristic quick / qeager bots; trial --quick, --base, --bar. Old idea ids no longer shadow live items in trials; trial runs are cached. 12 new tricks from the 27 Nov daily, tiered by hand (no rounds run).

20 new foes from the 27 Nov daily (endless straight away), each with a trick on your next turn: a daily draws its first foe from an easy pool and its second from a middling one; five deep foes only appear down the descent, which ramps faster (+3 HP a floor, +0.15 attack per three floors). HARD_HP / HARD_ATK levers (1 for now: the sword already raises foe HP). compare reports how often each foe ends a run. (1.8.0 left for an open PR.)

From the 27 Nov daily the Spellblade is a sword (scrawl-blade.js): hilt (block per letter), crossguard DL, tip DW, tiles in any slot; 8 runes offered at the Armoury beside the tricks (3 sockets, 3 levels); a holdover bag of 2; foe HP x2.4 on sword days in place of x1.27. Planner places each word on the hilt or where it hits hardest; drafts: tools / blade / runes.
Blade bonus squares (DL / TL / DW) from the 22 Nov daily; five new tools (Soften, Scribble, Lunge, Recoil, Triplicate) join the roster that day; planner scores each word by its letter order.
Items as data: every trick is read from scrawl-items.js, the same file the page uses; trick behaviour fingerprinted identical to 1.4.0 on page and sim.
Tiered equipment from the 21 Nov daily: 15-trick roster (common / uncommon / rare from the 1.2.0 trials), tiered Armoury offers; Swap, Rotate, Vowel Shift, Split and Ink Blot retired from offers.

Endless descent (deep runs: foes keep coming, every third is The Editor, +10% attack per set of three); fair draws from the 21 Nov daily on (no consonant twice in a hand, one of JQXZ, one of FKVWY), matching the page; fixtures recaptured.
Exactly reproducible (ties between equal plays now break the same way in every process); every trial includes all live tricks as controls, so the keeper bar is the same in every round.
Evolution rounds (trial, idea files with lineage, choose and pair trick kinds), selftest against the page, Lab snapshots.
Port of the four-card kit rules (Spellblade up to 6, daily edge, foe HP x1.22); notools, smart and eager bots; compare, sweep, report.
